lines.text: Welcome to MYTH or FACT! Today's myth: happy clients leave reviews... on their own!
Fact! Back in my day, good work spoke for itself.
Ooh, so close... but that's a MYTH! Happy clients usually just forget. A friendly text right after the job is what gets the review.
This is your FlowPilot speaking. Our review-request bot sends that text for you, right after every job. Comment MYTH for three more. You're still the captain.
